WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t1.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t1.ORGANIZATION_ID, t2.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, t2.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, t2.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG, MAX(t2.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID) OVER (ORDER BY t1.ORGANIZATION_ID ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS MAX_HR_ORG_UNIT_ID FROM `FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY` AS t0 JOIN `FCLT_ORGANIZATION` AS t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY JOIN `HR_ORG_UNIT` AS t2 ON t1.DLC_KEY = t2.DLC_KEY WHERE NOT t1.ORGANIZATION_ID IS NULL AND NOT t2.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID IS NULL AND t2.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Political Science' AND NOT t1.ORGANIZATION_ID IN ('138', '250')), DepartmentRoomAreaStddev AS (SELECT o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, STDDEV(r.AREA) AS area_stddev FROM `FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY` AS d JOIN `FCLT_ORGANIZATION` AS o ON d.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN `FCLT_ROOMS` AS r ON o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE NOT d.DLC_KEY IS NULL AND NOT o.ORGANIZATION_NAME IN ('ADMISSIONS') AND o.ORGANIZATION_NAME <> 'Political Science' GROUP BY o.ORGANIZATION_NAME HAVING COUNT(*) > 5), DepartmentRoomCount AS (SELECT o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, COUNT(r.FCLT_ROOM_KEY) AS total_room_count FROM `FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY` AS d JOIN `FCLT_ORGANIZATION` AS o ON d.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN `FCLT_ROOMS` AS r ON o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY GROUP BY o.ORGANIZATION_NAME) SELECT o1.ORGANIZATION_NAME, o1.ORGANIZATION_ID, o1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, o1.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, o1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG, o1.MAX_HR_ORG_UNIT_ID, d2.area_stddev, d3.total_room_count FROM inner_cte AS o1 LEFT JOIN DepartmentRoomAreaStddev AS d2 ON o1.ORGANIZATION_NAME = d2.ORGANIZATION_NAME LEFT JOIN DepartmentRoomCount AS d3 ON o1.ORGANIZATION_NAME = d3.ORGANIZATION_NAME ORDER BY o1.ORGANIZATION_ID

WITH subq1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT fb.BUILDING_NAME_LONG, fr.FCLT_FLOOR_KEY, MAX(fr.AREA) - MIN(fr.AREA) AS area_range, VARIANCE(fr.AREA) AS area_variance FROM `FCLT_ROOMS` AS fr JOIN `FCLT_BUILDING` AS fb ON fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE fr.ACCESS_LEVEL IN (1, 2) AND fb.BUILDING_TYPE = 'ACADEMIC' GROUP BY fb.BUILDING_NAME_LONG, fr.FCLT_FLOOR_KEY) SELECT ic.BUILDING_NAME_LONG, ff.FLOOR, ic.area_range, ic.area_variance, ff.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN `FCLT_FLOOR` AS ff ON ic.FCLT_FLOOR_KEY = ff.FCLT_FLOOR_KEY WHERE ff.ASSIGNABLE_AREA > 5000), subq2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (WITH floors_with_rooms AS (SELECT DISTINCT ff.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, ff.FLOOR, ff.ASSIGNABLE_AREA FROM `FCLT_FLOOR` AS ff JOIN `FCLT_ROOMS` AS fr ON ff.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY AND ff.FLOOR = fr.FLOOR), academic_buildings AS (SELECT DISTINCT fbh.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, fbh.BUILDING_NAME_LONG FROM `FCLT_BUILDING_HIST` AS fbh WHERE fbh.BUILDING_TYPE = 'ACADEMIC' AND fbh.SITE = 'MIT') SELECT ab.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, ab.BUILDING_NAME_LONG, MAX(fwr.ASSIGNABLE_AREA) - MIN(fwr.ASSIGNABLE_AREA) AS assignable_area_range, VARIANCE(fwr.ASSIGNABLE_AREA) AS assignable_area_variance FROM academic_buildings AS ab JOIN floors_with_rooms AS fwr ON ab.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fwr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY GROUP BY ab.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, ab.BUILDING_NAME_LONG) SELECT ic.BUILDING_NAME_LONG, ic.assignable_area_range, ic.assignable_area_variance, COUNT(fr.FCLT_ROOM_KEY) AS total_room_count, ic.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY FROM inner_cte AS ic LEFT JOIN `FCLT_ROOMS` AS fr ON ic.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY GROUP BY ic.BUILDING_NAME_LONG, ic.assignable_area_range, ic.assignable_area_variance, ic.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY) SELECT s1.BUILDING_NAME_LONG, s1.FLOOR, s1.area_range, s1.area_variance, s2.assignable_area_range, s2.assignable_area_variance, s2.total_room_count FROM subq1 AS s1 JOIN subq2 AS s2 ON s1.BUILDING_NAME_LONG = s2.BUILDING_NAME_LONG AND s1.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = s2.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY ORDER BY s1.BUILDING_NAME_LONG, s1.FLOOR

MIN(TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_range, VARIANCE(TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_variance, MAX(ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC) AS academic_year_desc FROM inner_cte1 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR, DEPARTMENT_NAME WITH ROLLUP), SubjectUnitsStats AS (SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(academic_year) OVER (ORDER BY year_sort, academic_year, dept_sort) = academic_year THEN NULL ELSE academic_year END AS academic_year, academic_year_desc, dept, units_range, units_variance FROM cte_subject_units AS tbl ORDER BY year_sort, dept_sort), inner_cte2 AS (SELECT b.BUILDING_NAME, MAX(r.AREA) - WITH OrgDlcStats AS (SELECT d.DLC_KEY, o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, COUNT(o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS organization_count, MIN(o.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) AS min_organization_number FROM `FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY` AS d JOIN `FCLT_ORGANIZATION` AS o ON d.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE o.ASSIGNABLE = 1 AND NOT d.DLC_KEY IS NULL AND o.ORGANIZATION_NAME <> 'ADMISSIONS' AND NOT o.ORGANIZATION_ID IN ('138', '250') GROUP BY d.DLC_KEY, o.ORGANIZATION_NAME), BuildingRoomStats AS (SELECT b.BUILDING_NAME, MAX(r.AREA) - MIN(r.AREA) AS area_range, VARIANCE(r.AREA) AS area_variance, STDDEV(r.AREA) AS area_stddev FROM `FCLT_BUILDING` AS b JOIN `FCLT_ROOMS` AS r ON b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = r.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE b.SITE = 'MIT' AND b.BUILDING_TYPE = 'ACADEMIC' GROUP BY b.BUILDING_NAME HAVING COUNT(r.FCLT_ROOM_KEY) > 10 ORDER BY area_range DESC) SELECT ods.DLC_KEY, ods.ORGANIZATION_NAME, ods.organization_count, ods.min_organization_number, brs.BUILDING_NAME, brs.area_range, brs.area_variance, brs.area_stddev FROM OrgDlcStats AS ods CROSS JOIN BuildingRoomStats AS brs
